title: Uplifting Ethiopian Chicken Curry
description: A funky and creamy Ethiopian dish featuring gochugaru and flambe, served in a scallop shell, this curry is a unique and delicious experience, and is egg-free-friendly for all to enjoy.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large pan over medium heat.
Add the onion and cook until it is translucent.
Add the garlic and ginger and cook for 1 minute.
Add the gochugaru and cook for 1 minute.
Add the chicken breast and cook until it is browned on all sides.
Add the tomato paste and cook for 1 minute.
Add the coconut milk and bring the mixture to a simmer.
Reduce the heat to low and let the curry simmer for 20 minutes.
Season the curry with salt and black pepper to taste.
Flambe the curry by adding a small amount of oil to the pan and igniting it.
Serve the curry in scallop shells and enjoy.
Ensure poultry is cooked to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F (juices run clear, no pink remaining) before serving.
